_source: AI-researched NEW DISTRICT candidates for Manchester and Cheshire, awaiting review — never directly promoted by the research agent. Populated by the same daily scheduled research agent as venue-suggestions.json (2026-08, at explicit user request), committed straight to master the same way (see that file's own doc comment for why). Expected to be rare: the research brief (.claude/agents/curia-research-daily.md) treats district suggestions as an occasional finding (a genuinely distinct, not-yet-covered high-end area within Manchester or Cheshire), not a daily quota — most days should add zero entries here. The daily curia-suggestion-review agent (.claude/agents/curia-suggestion-review.md) is the only thing that promotes an entry into the real docs/data/districts.json, behind its own pull request. Each entry mirrors docs/data/districts.json's own raw shape (name/metro/lat/lon/base/kind/accentColor/editorialDescription) so an approved entry can be copied straight in, plus review-only fields (suggestedDate, status, researchNotes) stripped on promotion. `metro` must be 'manchester' or 'cheshire' only — never 'los-angeles' or a new metro (out of scope, per the user's explicit 'shouldn't go beyond cheshire and manchester just yet').
_reviewWorkflow: Same as venue-suggestions.json: status starts 'pending', the review agent flips it to 'approved' (then copies fields into districts.json, as part of its own PR) or 'rejected' (kept here with researchNotes so it isn't re-suggested). A human's real review happens by reading/merging that PR.

suggestions.name: Heaton Moor
suggestions.editorialDescription: One of the Four Heatons, and the one with the actual high street — Heaton Moor Road and Shaw Road doing a quieter version of what Chorlton and Didsbury do further south. A 1923 cinema saved twice, most recently by a family who bought it back from the multiplex era, and a producers' market that still runs on a Saturday.
suggestions.researchNotes: Genuinely distinct, well-known south Manchester/Stockport suburb (part of 'The Heatons' — Heaton Moor, Heaton Chapel, Heaton Norris, Heaton Mersey) that doesn't overlap any of the 17 existing districts, including the two other Stockport-borough entries already seeded (Stockport (Underbanks), the regeneration-era town-centre market/bank-vault quarter several hundred metres south with a wholly different character; Cheadle Hulme, several miles further south, leafier and without a defined independent high street). Confirmed via hardens.com, squaremeal.co.uk, stockport.nub.news and tasteofmanchester.com as having its own real, independent-heavy food and drink strip on Heaton Moor Road/Shaw Road (Leoni's, Casa de Moor's own sibling Casa De Casa — already referenced by name in venues.json's own Casa de Moor note — Cork of the North wine merchant, Stockport Bottle, Heaton Producers Market), distinct in character from both Chorlton's beer-mile/tapas identity and Stockport (Underbanks)'s bank-vault regeneration story. The Savoy Cinema — an independent, family-owned 1923 picture house, closed in 2014 and reopened as a boutique cinema in 2015 by the Mundin family (confirmed via Companies House: Savoy Cinema Heaton Moor Limited, and the cinema's own site) — anchors the area the same way The Edge Theatre anchors Chorlton. Coordinates (53.4213/-2.1857) cross-checked against three independent mapping sources for Heaton Moor Road, landing within ~150m of each other, and pass the lat 53.0-53.6/lon -2.6--2.0 sanity box. Metro assigned 'manchester'/kind 'city' on the same Greater-Manchester-shorthand judgment already applied to Stockport (Underbanks) — Heaton Moor is administratively in the Metropolitan Borough of Stockport, not the City of Manchester, but reads as a dense suburban high street, closer in character to Chorlton/Didsbury than to any Cheshire county town. accentColor (#6B7F94, dusty slate blue) chosen for perceptual distinctness against its nearest neighbours — Stockport (Underbanks)'s deep brick-wine (#7A3B3E), Didsbury's dusty rose (#B98098), Chorlton's sage green (#6B8F71) — no other district in the current set reads blue-grey. Deliberately no venues seeded here yet — same starting point Chorlton, Didsbury and Stockport (Underbanks) each had before their own first venue passes; a first venue pass is separate follow-up work for a future run, not done here.
